name: Team Member One
bio: This profile introduces a designer whose work begins with close observation of the ground. Their interests include topography, water, and the everyday ways people inhabit shared space. Within the studio, they help connect early site research to the development of spatial ideas, moving between field notes, drawings, and physical studies.

Their approach is patient and collaborative: asking what is already working in a place before proposing what might change. They are currently exploring how public landscapes can accommodate seasonal flooding while remaining useful and welcoming throughout the year. A finished biography would add their background, education, previous experience, and selected projects, together with a more personal account of what draws them to landscape practice.
bCaption: A personal interest, a field note, or an unexpected side. More to follow.
